arxiv-1904-02040.title: CP-Violation phase analysis via non-trivial correlation of quarks and leptons in 3+1 scenario
arxiv-1904-02040.creator: Gazal Sharma, B. C. Chauhan
arxiv-1904-02040.description: Abstract The existence and mysterious nature of sterile neutrinos are revolutionizing physics from the particle level to the cosmological scales. The recent results from the MiniBooNE experiment at Fermi-lab observed far more ν e \nu_{e} appearance than expected, which have provided a hint about the possible existence of sterile neutrinos .

arxiv-2103-00008.title: Topological Dipole Conserving Insulators and Multipolar Responses
arxiv-2103-00008.creator: Julian May-Mann, Taylor L. Hughes
arxiv-2103-00008.description: Abstract Higher order topological insulators (HOTIs) are a novel form of insulating quantum matter, which are characterized by having gapped boundaries that are separated by gapless corner or hinge states. Recently, it has been proposed that the essential features of a large class of HOTIs are captured by topological multipolar response theories.

arxiv-2112-00701.title: Julia sets of hyperbolic rational maps have positive Fourier dimension
arxiv-2112-00701.creator: Gaétan Leclerc
arxiv-2112-00701.description: Abstract Let f : ℂ ^ → ℂ ^ f:\widehat{\mathbb{C}}\rightarrow\widehat{\mathbb{C}} be a hyperbolic rational map of degree d ≥ 2 d\geq 2 , and let J ⊂ ℂ J\subset\mathbb{C} be its Julia set. We prove that J J always has positive Fourier dimension.

arxiv-2209-11106.title: Updated and novel limits on double beta decay and dark matter-induced processes in platinum Journal: Eur. Phys. J. C
arxiv-2209-11106.creator: B. Broerman e1,queens, M. Laubenstein lngs, S.S. Nagorny e2,queens,mi, S. Nisi lngs, N. Song e3,liverpool,itp, A.C. Vincent queens,mi,pi
arxiv-2209-11106.description: Abstract A 510 day long-term measurement of a 45.3 g platinum foil acting as the sample and high voltage contact in an ultra-low-background high purity germanium detector was performed at Laboratori Nazionali del Gran Sasso (Italy). The data was used for a detailed study of double beta decay modes in natural platinum isotopes.

arxiv-2309-14733.title: Kolmogorov equations with singular paracontrolled terminal conditions
arxiv-2309-14733.creator: Helena Kremp, Nicolas Perkowski
arxiv-2309-14733.description: Abstract Fractional Kolmogorov equations with singular paracontrolled terminal conditions Helena Kremp 1 1 1 Technische Universität Wien, helena.kremp@asc.tuwien.ac.at , Nicolas Perkowski 2 2 2 Freie Universität Berlin, perkowski@math.fu-berlin.de We consider backward fractional Kolmogorov equations with singular Besov drift of low regularity and singular terminal conditions.

arxiv-2309-15345.title: Simulation of noisy Clifford circuits without fault propagation
arxiv-2309-15345.creator: Nicolas Delfosse, Adam Paetznick
arxiv-2309-15345.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Nicolas Delfosse, Adam Paetznick. The design and optimization of a large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computer architecture relies extensively on numerical simulations to assess the performance of each component of the architecture. The simulation of fault-tolerant gadgets, which are typically implemented by Clifford circuits, is done by sampling circuit faults and propagating them through the circuit to check that they do not corrupt the logical data.

arxiv-2405-07006.title: Word-specific tonal realizations in Mandarin
arxiv-2405-07006.creator: Yu-Ying Chuang, Melanie J. Bell, Yu-Hsiang Tseng, R. Harald Baayen
arxiv-2405-07006.description: Abstract Abstract The pitch contours of Mandarin two-character words are generally understood as being shaped by the underlying tones of the constituent single-character words, in interaction with articulatory constraints imposed by factors such as speech rate, co-articulation with adjacent tones, segmental make-up, and predictability. This study shows that tonal realization is also partially determined by words’ meanings.

arxiv-2505-15044.title: Learning-based Airflow Inertial Odometry for MAVs using Thermal Anemometers in a GPS and vision denied environment
arxiv-2505-15044.creator: Ze Wang, Jingang Qu, Zhenyu Gao, Pascal Morin
arxiv-2505-15044.description: Abstract This work demonstrates an airflow inertial based odometry system with multi-sensor data fusion, including thermal anemometer, IMU, ESC, and barometer. This goal is challenging because low-cost IMUs and barometers have significant bias, and anemometer measurements are very susceptible to interference from spinning propellers and ground effects.

arxiv-2507-20486.title: Tangent Lie Algebras of Automorphism Groups of Free Algebras
arxiv-2507-20486.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . We study an analogue of the Andreadakis–Johnson filtration for automorphism groups of free algebras and introduce the notion of tangent Lie algebras for certain automorphism groups, defined as subalgebras of the Lie algebra of derivations. We show that, for many classical varieties of algebras, the tangent Lie algebra is contained in the Lie algebra of derivations with constant divergence.

arxiv-2509-13208.title: It Takes a Village: Bridging the Gaps between Current and Formal Specifications for Protocols CCS: Networks Network protocol design CCS: Networks Protocol correctness CCS: Networks Network security CCS: Security and privacy Formal methods and theory of security CCS: Theory of computation Logic Journ
arxiv-2509-13208.creator: David Basin, Nate Foster, Kenneth L. McMillan, Kedar S. Namjoshi, Cristina Nita-Rotaru, Jonathan M. Smith, Pamela Zave, Lenore D. Zuck
arxiv-2509-13208.description: Abstract . Formal specifications have numerous benefits for both designers and users of network protocols. They provide clear, unambiguous representations, which are useful as documentation and for testing. They can help reveal disagreements about what a protocol “is” and identify areas where further work is needed to resolve ambiguities or internal inconsistencies.

arxiv-2602-15408.title: Constant curvature rotational nets and periodic Bäcklund transforms
arxiv-2602-15408.creator: T. Raujouan, W. Rossman, N. Suda
arxiv-2602-15408.description: Abstract . After giving explicit parametrizations of discrete constant negative Gaussian curvature surfaces (negative CGC, i.e. discrete pseudospherical surfaces) of revolution, we construct Bäcklund transformations that again will have explicit parametrizations and are new examples of non-rotational discrete pseudospherical surfaces.

pmc-10674780.creator: Mai M Sayed, Zohour I Nabil, Nahla S El-Shenawy, Rasha A Al-Eisa, Mohamed S Nafie, Nuno Manuel Xavier
pmc-10674780.description: To discover potential cytotoxic agents, new semi-synthetic phenoxy acetamide derivatives, compound I and compound II, were synthesized, characterized, and screened for their cytotoxic activity against breast cancer (MCF-7) and liver cancer (HepG2) cell lines. The two compounds were more promising against HepG2 than the MCF-7 cell line according to IC50 values.

pmc-11314353.title: Genome-Wide Analysis of DNA Demethylases in Land Plants and Their Expression Pattern in Rice
pmc-11314353.creator: Shengxin Mao, Jian Xiao, Yating Zhao, Jiaqi Hou, Lijia Li
pmc-11314353.description: DNA demethylation is a very important biochemical pathway regulating a group of biological processes, such as embryo development, fruit ripening, and response to stress. Despite the essential role of DNA demethylases, their evolutionary relationship and detailed biological functions in different land plants remain unclear. In this study, 48 DNA demethylases in 12 land plants were identified and classified.

pmc-11355611.title: Reaction to Disease and Coping Strategies in Stressful Situations among Psoriasis Patients: Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-11355611.creator: Beata Kowalewska, Marta Milewska-Buzun, Mateusz Cybulski, Andriej Szpakow, Dzmitry Khvorik, Marek Sobolewski, Piotr Aleksiejczuk, Wiaczesław Niczyporuk
pmc-11355611.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: In the contemporary world, a cult of perfection is being created, and deviations from such an ideal image are becoming socially unacceptable. A particular situation arises when a defect or symptoms of a disease appear on the skin, which, in the case of people suffering from psoriasis, are a source of stress, dissatisfaction with the disease, and a reduction in quality of life.

pmc-12514954.title: Patients with Higher Exacerbation Burden and Eosinophil Counts are More Likely to Require Multiple Biologics for Asthma Control
pmc-12514954.creator: Alyson N Brown, Tanawin Nopsopon, Ayobami Akenroye
pmc-12514954.description: BackgroundMultiple biologics are now available for severe asthma, creating opportunities to switch between therapies.PurposeTo identify characteristics of patients with asthma who switch biologics.MethodsWe examined biologic switching in 1611 patients with moderate-to-severe asthma on maintenance therapy who initiated a biologic between 2014 and 2023 within a large health system and had no alternate indication.

pmc-12553542.title: Influence of recent randomized MeVO trials on current practice patterns and future role of MeVO thrombectomy
pmc-12553542.creator: Salome Lou Bosshart, Yu Zhou, Alexander Stebner, Nima Kashani, Mayank Goyal, Michael Hill, Bijoy Menon, Mohammed Almekhlafi, Aravind Ganesh, Nishita Singh, Andrew Demchuk, Jianmin Liu, Johanna Maria Ospel
pmc-12553542.description: IntroductionNumerous non-randomized studies suggest the benefit of endovascular thrombectomy (EVT) for medium vessel occlusion (MeVO) stroke, while recent randomized trials showed no benefit. In clinical practice, MeVO management remains heterogeneous. We gauged the current status quo of endovascular MeVO management and physicians’ perspectives on future MeVO-EVT trials.

pmc-12736192.creator: Giedrius Šidlauskas, Naglis Gudiškis, Dovilė Laisvūnė Bagdonaitė, Eglė Rudaitytė-Lukošienė, Evelina Juozaitytė-Ngugu, Marius Jasiulionis, Linas Balčiauskas, Dalius Butkauskas, Petras Prakas, Marcello Otake Sato
pmc-12736192.description: Toxoplasma gondii, a widespread parasite, poses significant public health concerns. It infects humans and animals, with rodents serving as important intermediate hosts. The present study investigated the prevalence and genetic ITS1 diversity of T. gondii in wild rodents from Lithuania.

pmc-13652853.title: Development and validation of an artificial intelligence model for basal cell carcinoma detection and section completeness assessment in Mohs micrographic surgery in an Asian cohort
pmc-13652853.creator: Li Yang Loo, Wen-Bin Luo, Isaac Hong-Kei Lam, Seow Ye Heng, Fan Foon Cheo, John Huang, Shang Wei Song, Terrence Yeoh, Fung Xue Feng, Siti Nuruljannah Baharudin, Li Yan Khor, Chee Leong Cheng, Po Yin Tang, Choon Chiat Oh
pmc-13652853.description: BackgroundMohs micrographic surgery for basal cell carcinoma (BCC) requires rapid intraoperative histologic interpretation. This is labor-intensive and incomplete tissue sections compromise margin assessment. Artificial intelligence has shown promise in BCC detection but section completeness assessment remains underexplored.ObjectiveDevelop and validate an artificial intelligence model for BCC detection and section completeness assessment on Mohs frozen-section histology.

pmc-13675775.title: Developmental pathways to autism in tuberous sclerosis complex: Evidence from a longitudinal cohort
pmc-13675775.creator: Fiona S McEwen, Abigail K Runicles, Holan Liang, Emma Woodhouse, Lisa Underwood, Elizabeth Shephard, Edward D Barker, Fintan Sheerin, Juul W Steenbruggen, Tuberous Sclerosis 2000 Study Group, John R W Yates, Charlotte Tye, Patrick F Bolton
pmc-13675775.description: The association between autism spectrum disorder (hereafter referred to as autism) and tuberous sclerosis complex (TSC) is well established, yet the developmental pathways linking genetic mutation, cortical pathology, and epilepsy with autism remain unclear. The Tuberous Sclerosis 2000 Study recruited children newly diagnosed with TSC (N = 125).

uslaw-usc-t29-s2611.title: 29 U.S.C. § 2611 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t29-s2611.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t29-s2611.description: United States Code, Title 29 (Labor); Chapter 28 (Family And Medical Leave); Subchapter I (General Requirements For Leave). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. As used in this subchapter: (1) Commerce The terms “commerce” and “industry or activity affecting commerce” mean any activity, business, or industry in commerce or in which a labor dispute would hinder or obstruct commerce or the free flow.

uslaw-usc-t42-s14954.title: 42 U.S.C. § 14954 — No private right of action
uslaw-usc-t42-s14954.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s14954.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 143 (Intercountry Adoptions); Subchapter V (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Convention and this chapter shall not be construed to create a private right of action to seek administrative or judicial relief, except to the extent expressly provided in this chapter.
